designNotes: Do not equate the June 5 wiki index count with the current total number of quests; later/omitted quests are documented separately.
Map markers should primarily focus on proximity, arrival, scan, and interaction starts. Automatic story-chain quests should not clutter the map by default.
Quest objectives can reference existing POIs without creating duplicate permanent markers.
One Before Me proximity trigger at Sanctuary Dock 12 is both wiki-confirmed and explicitly confirmed by the user from their playthrough.
Project Jonah whale encounters are modeled as quest-unlocked world events, not ordinary quest objectives.
